name: Bright Clean
short_description: Keep the exact product from the input image completely unchanged - preserve its colors, shape, texture, and all visual characteristics. Only change the background to a seamless pure white studio background and adjust the lighting to bright, even studio lighting. The product itself must remain identical to the input.
product_preservation_instruction: CRITICAL: The product must remain visually identical to the input image. Do not alter, reinterpret, or regenerate the product. Only modify the environment (background, lighting, shadows) around the unchanged product.

objects.description: The exact product from the input image, preserved as-is, centered in frame with optimal lighting
objects.orientation: facing forward, slightly angled for dimension
objects.shape_and_color: Natural product colors with accurate color reproduction
objects.texture: Clean, well-defined surfaces with visible material quality
objects.appearance_details: Sharp details with high clarity, minimal shadows, brand new appearance

background_setting: Seamless pure white studio background, providing clean and uncluttered environment that highlights the product

lighting.shadows: soft, subtle shadows directly beneath product, indicating depth without distraction

photographic_characteristics.depth_of_field: moderate, product in sharp focus with minimal background blur
